Amazon knocks $150 off Pixel 11 phones, with up to $200 in gift cards
items.summary:
The Pixel 11 in hibiscus. | Image: The Verge	

If you’ve been on the fence about Google’s latest Pixel phones, this might be your best chance to save some cash. Amazon is offering an extra $150 off the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL when you use the coupon code PIXEL11 at checkout. While the discounted price appeared at checkout for most phone and watch combinations, it didn’t apply to the Pixel Pro Fold.
That deal stacks with the introductory offer running at several retailers, where you can choose between a gift card that scales with the model of phone you’re buying, or additional credit towards a Pixel Watch 5. For example, the base model Pixel 11 would normally cost $899, but the introductory bundle, which ends on August 27th, includes a $100 gift card, and with the code, you’ll pay just $749. The Pixel 11 Pro and Pro XL bundles include either a $200 gift card, or $250 towards the cost of a Pixel Watch 5.
Google Pixel 11

Where to Buy:

 $899 at Amazon (with $100 gift card)

The Pixel 11 phones added a variety of new features to Google’s first-party Android phones, most notably around the cameras. In addition to improved sensors across the lineup, the new Magic Capture feature automatically pulls photos and clips out of a video recording, letting you focus on what’s in front of you.
Read our Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro reviews.
Other deals to consider
Doom: The Dark Ages is on sale for $19.87 at Green Man Gaming, the lowest price yet for the Steam version of the game. The 2025 title adds a medieval twist to the classic Doom formula, with a more engaging story, and of course an awesome suite of weapons, including a shield that gives you more options while charging into battle. Read our review.
 Best Buy is selling the Scuf Valor Pro for $113.99, a significant discount from its usual price of $189.99. This wireless controller is compatible with PC, Xbox Series S/X, and Xbox One, and features TMR joysticks to prevent stick drift over time. It has a 1,000 Hz polling rate when connected to a computer for super sharp response times, and programmable paddles on the back. 
The Cuktech 25,000mAh 100W USB-C power bank is only $62.99 at Amazon for a limited time, 10 percent lower than the usual price. It can charge up to three devices at once, with an integrated USB-C cable, as well as USB-C and USB-A ports, with up to 100W of charging power.

Being a mom is hard — the heat is making it harder
items.summary:
It's 8:52 AM and 86 degrees Fahrenheit (30 Celsius) where I live in Southern California. My husband just came back from a morning outing with our four-month-old. "How was the botanic garden?" I ask him. "It was okay. It was just too hot," he tells me. I didn't expect us to spend so much of our son's first summer cooped up inside, hiding from the heat.

The Switch 2’s $50 price increase is happening next week
items.summary:
This is a friendly reminder that the Nintendo Switch 2 will jump in price by $50 starting on September 1st. That’s next Tuesday! The company gave plenty of notice, but the time has finally come. The base 256GB model that ships without a game will go from $449.99 to $499.99. Nintendo recently announced two bundles (both well over $500) shipping this fall that include a game with a slight discount.
If you’re on the fence for a Switch 2, now is a pretty good time to buy one — not just because of the upcoming price increase. The game library is stellar and growing quickly, and the console itself is great, too. You’ll need one to play the remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, The Duskbloods, and plenty of other upcoming games.
Nintendo Switch 2
The Nintendo Switch 2 has a 7.9-inch LCD display, magnetically attached Joy-Con 2 controllers, backwards compatibility with most original Switch games, and exclusive titles including Donkey Kong Bananza and Kirby Air Riders. Read our review.

Where to Buy:

 $449.99 at Amazon
 $449.99 at Best Buy
 $449.99 at Target

Not that the Switch 2 was ever cheap, but it was one of a few devices left out there that didn’t quickly get more expensive due to RAMageddon. Alas, no tech product will escape RAMageddon unscathed, especially one like the Switch 2 that has speedy RAM and storage. Almost all competing handhelds cost more than before, too, though Nintendo’s $50 price increase is soft compared to the $200-plus increase for the Steam Deck OLED .
And, in case you were wondering, we’ve tested some great Switch 2 accessories, and have put our favorites into respective articles that deliver multiple options. We landed on the best cases, the best screen protectors, and the best controllers, too.

items.title: Volvo’s cars will warn one another about hazards in the road
items.summary:
Volvo is updating three of its electric vehicles with new hazard alerts to warn drivers when there are animals or vulnerable road users ahead. The new connected safety features are based on Volvo's cars talking to one another, as opposed to crowdsourced alert systems used by popular navigation tools like Google Maps and Waze. 
The alerts work by using connected vehicle data from Volvo's fleet of passenger vehicles in Europe, the US, and Canada. The car's sensors and cameras are tuned to identify certain risks on the road. When one Volvo spots a hazard, it automatically logs the location and sends it to Volvo's servers. Alerts are then sent  …

items.title: Elden Ring on the Switch 2 isn’t tarnished
items.summary:
FromSoftware is hoping to make a splash on the Switch 2 later this year when it launches The Duskbloods, a gothic competitive multiplayer game that's unlike anything the studio has made before. But before that, Switch 2 owners have a chance to experience the studio's biggest hit for the first time thanks to a port of Elden Ring and its expansion, Shadow of the Erdtree. For the most part, the new version - called the "Tarnished Edition" - is the same game that captivated players in 2022. But the shift in platform also makes it a particularly compelling way to explore the Lands Between.
